hero.title: Experience the Lake's Spirit
hero.subtitle: A rustic deck on the water where sunsets meet handcrafted bites, signature drinks, and warm company.

story.title: Cozy by the lake
story.p1: Born between weathered planks and the golden mirror of the lake, Bar do Lago is a refuge for honest pauses. Every plate carries the taste of the land; every drink, the calm of the water.
story.p2: For over a decade we've welcomed friends, travelers and locals like family — always with low flames, low music, and a privileged view.

menu.title: Flavors of the shore
menu.intro: Recipes inspired by the lake and its seasons. Local ingredients, attentive hands.

d1.d: Gin, lemongrass, wild honey, dry tonic.

a1.d: Cured cheeses, artisan charcuterie, rustic bread.

a2.d: Crisp dough filled with pine nuts and mountain cheese.

a3.d: Lake tilapia, fresh herbs, smoked aioli.

m2.d: Twelve hours over low fire, creamy polenta, salsa verde.

m3.d: Funghi, aged parmesan, red wine reduction.
